newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to weaker.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to weaker on Friday, traders said.
Naphtha held steady in quiet trade. Physical cargoes were pegged around unchanged at $230 cif
Gasoline was slightly weaker amid scant demand in Europe and a closed arbirage window to the U.S.
Spot gas oil prices were holding steady at the lower levels in late trade underpinned by an afternoon upturn in benchmark gas oil futures but physical buying interest stayed thin.
High sulphur fuel oil was steady to weaker amid more volatility on the barge market, traders said.
